evidence.title: GitHub - TheOrcDev/repostars: Modern, themeable GitHub star history charts. Open source, free, embeddable.

name: RepoStars
summary: Themeable GitHub star history charts: compare up to five repos and embed a live sparkline in a README.
description: Web tool and API for charting exact per-day GitHub star history of any public repository. Compare up to five repos on one time axis, switch between 20 themes, export a 2400×1260 PNG or embed a 700×420 SVG sparkline in a README; share cards and JSON history come from public endpoints.
contains: exact per-day star counts from GitHub's privacy-safe star history endpoint
compare up to 5 repos on one time axis
20 themes incl. dark, light, neon, 8-bit and synthwave
PNG export at 2400×1260 and README embed as a 700×420 SVG sparkline
shareable links that keep repos and theme in the URL
